title: Turnover & Property Operations
core_problem: Airbnb hosts with 1-5 properties face a related cluster of problems around turnover & property operations — e.g. cleaner turnover coordination, supply restocking tracking, welcome book contents unclear.
desired_outcome: A shared outcome across member problems: Standardize every turnover. Never run out of guest supplies. Produce a house manual without tool failures.
primary_question: Do real people experience this problem, what does it look like, what outcome do they want, what have they tried, what remains unsolved?
